offering_description.value: Provides healthcare workforce solutions to hospitals, health systems and other healthcare facilities. It places travel nurses, allied health professionals, locum tenens physicians and permanent hires, and offers vendor management, scheduling software and language interpretation services.

primary_products.value: workforce management software; scheduling and vendor management platforms; video remote interpretation technology

primary_services.value: temporary nurse and allied staffing; locum tenens physician staffing; managed services programs; permanent placement and executive search; language interpretation

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, clinics, physician practices and other healthcare facilities; B2G: government facilities such as VA and public health agencies

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospitals and health systems; physician practices; public health

revenue_model.value: service fees: billed hourly rates for temporary clinicians placed at client facilities; subscription: workforce technology and vendor management platform fees; commissions or management fees: managed services program fees and permanent placement fees
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: recruits and employs clinicians and places them with healthcare facilities; software / platform: provides scheduling, vendor management and interpretation technology to healthcare clients

geography_served.value: US national: Clinicians placed across the United States, with some international recruiting

specialization.value: related lines: nurse and allied staffing, physician staffing, technology and workforce solutions, language services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving hospitals and health systems, including multi-year managed services contracts; online: job portals and platforms for clinicians to find assignments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: staffing and employment rules, healthcare credentialing, wage and hour laws, HIPAA, and state licensing of clinicians
